name: Market Microstructure and Trade Execution

concepts.concept: Bid-ask spread, midpoint and relative spread
concepts.summary: Buy at ask, sell at bid; spread = ask - bid is the round-trip immediacy cost; relative spread = spread/midpoint.

sources.chapter: Ch. 4 Market-Making Mechanics
sources.note: Bid/ask, market spread as market-maker profit; liquid markets have smaller spreads; widening spreads signal freezing liquidity.

concepts.concept: Market vs limit orders, marketability and fill risk
concepts.summary: Market orders guarantee execution, not price; limits guarantee price, not fill; buy limits below the ask rest.

concepts.concept: Order book depth, walking the book and order imbalance
concepts.summary: Large market orders walk successive levels (average price worse than best quote); depth matters; imbalance is a noisy signal.

concepts.summary: Slippage = execution vs pre-trade reference price; impact grows with size relative to liquidity; partly temporary, partly permanent.
